description: This file defines the RouteParser class in the Slim Framework, providing methods for generating URLs based on route names and parameters, as well as parsing route patterns.

classes.name: RouteParser
classes.description: Implements route parsing and URL generation methods for the Slim Framework's routing system.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the RouteParser with a RouteCollectorInterface.

methods.name: relativeUrlFor
methods.description: Generates a relative URL for a named route using provided data and query parameters.

methods.name: urlFor
methods.description: Generates an absolute URL for a named route, considering the base path.

methods.name: fullUrlFor
methods.description: Constructs a full URL including scheme and authority based on a UriInterface, route name, and data.
